# openinfra_processing_job (Resource)

A run-once, GPU-capable data-processing job (SageMaker Processing) — preprocessing, feature engineering, dataset validation, or model evaluation with N named inputs and outputs. More general than openinfra_batch_transform (single-model inference).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) Processing container. Reads its inputs, writes its outputs, and runs to completion.
- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `args` (List of String) Optional container args.
- `backoff_limit` (Number) Pod retries before the job is marked Failed.
- `command` (List of String) Optional entrypoint override.
- `cpu` (String) CPU request/limit.
- `env` (Attributes List) Environment variables for the processing container. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--env))
- `gpu` (Number) GPUs to request. `0` (default) runs CPU-only.
- `gpu_tier` (String) GPU class when gpu>0. One of: `smallgpu`, `largegpu`.
- `inputs` (Attributes List) Named input channels (injected as INPUT_<NAME>_BUCKET/PREFIX + S3 creds). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--inputs))
- `max_runtime_seconds` (Number) Hard wall-clock cap (Job activeDeadlineSeconds). Unset means no cap.
- `memory` (String) Memory request/limit.
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `outputs` (Attributes List) Named output channels (injected as OUTPUT_<NAME>_BUCKET/PREFIX; buckets created on demand). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--outputs))
- `secrets` (List of String) Extra secrets to inject with envFrom.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `job_name` (String) The batch Job the run executes as.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.
